## Workflow C · Notifications
Triggered by Workflow B when matching finishes.

* One email per user, all their matches in one table
* Recipients are **always rewritten to TEST_INBOX_ALIASES** (never the CSV address)
* Sent with the **AWS SES node** (default). `EMAIL_USE_GMAIL=true` switches to a Gmail SMTP fallback
* `NOTIFY_MAX_EMAILS` caps a run · only accepted emails are marked notified

parameters.query:
-- Users with matches that have never been emailed, one row per user with their
-- products pre-aggregated (so the email builder needs no extra queries).
-- $1 = batch_id ('any' = every batch), $2 = max emails this run (demo safety cap).
WITH pending AS (
    SELECT m.user_id,
           max(m.batch_id::text) AS batch_id,
           max(m.score)          AS best_score,
           json_agg(json_build_object(
               'product_id', p.product_id, 'lender', p.lender, 'product_name', p.product_name,
               'rate_min', p.interest_rate_min, 'rate_max', p.interest_rate_max,
               'processing_fee', p.processing_fee, 'score', m.score, 'reason', m.reason,
               'source_url', p.source_url) ORDER BY m.score DESC) AS products
    FROM matches m
    JOIN loan_products p USING (product_id)
    WHERE m.notified_at IS NULL
      AND ($1 = 'any' OR m.batch_id = NULLIF($1, 'any')::uuid)
    GROUP BY m.user_id
)
SELECT u.user_id, u.name, u.email, u.monthly_income, u.credit_score, u.employment_status,
       pending.batch_id, pending.products
FROM pending
JOIN users u USING (user_id)
ORDER BY json_array_length(pending.products) DESC, pending.best_score DESC
LIMIT $2::int;

-- Log the sends, stamp the matches as notified and close out the batch, atomically.
-- $1 = sent rows (JSON), $2 = batch_id, $3 = JSON-encoded error summary ('' if none).
WITH sent AS (
    SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb)
        AS x(user_id text, sent_to text, product_ids int[], batch_id uuid, ses_message_id text)
),
logged AS (
    INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, sent_to, product_ids, batch_id, ses_message_id)
    SELECT user_id, sent_to, product_ids, batch_id, ses_message_id FROM sent
    RETURNING 1
),
stamped AS (
    UPDATE matches m SET notified_at = now()
    FROM sent
    WHERE m.user_id = sent.user_id AND m.product_id = ANY (sent.product_ids)
    RETURNING 1
),
batch AS (
    -- 'notified' if at least one email went out, otherwise surface the SES error to the UI
    UPDATE upload_batches
    SET status = CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM sent) > 0 THEN 'notified' ELSE 'notify_failed' END,
        error = NULLIF($3::jsonb #>> '{}', ''),   -- $3 arrives JSON-encoded (may contain commas)
        updated_at = now(),
        match_stats = COALESCE(match_stats, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('emails_sent', (SELECT count(*) FROM sent))
    WHERE batch_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT batch_id FROM sent) OR batch_id::text = $2
    RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM logged)::int  AS emails_logged,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM stamped)::int AS matches_marked,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM batch)::int   AS batches_closed;
